description: Bangladesh National Grid Daily Peak Electricity Demand Dataset (2016–2024), published by Dipayan Bhadra, curates national daily day-peak and evening-peak electricity demand from Power Grid Bangladesh reports. Coverage: Bangladesh national day and evening peaks, 1 January 2016 through 30 September 2024. The repository supplies a public deposit and file listing. Only metadata was read; the files, schemas and calculations were not executed or checked. The deposit is marked CC-BY-4.0. Its public landing page and listed open files are available without a login; upstream source conditions may also apply. Limitations: The source claims prior peer-reviewed use, but its linked article is a preprint. Reuse remains unverified. No weather, economic or other exogenous variables are included. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
